fusions.name: Throat Hold
fusions.desc: Usable only on a target at or below 25% health, a threshold that rises with each rank. A bite at the throat that deals 20 damage and uses up every affliction on it, adding 1.5 times the damage they had left.

fusions.name: Pounce from Cover
fusions.desc: Springs you at an enemy up to 6 tiles away. The landing deals 12 damage to every enemy within 2 tiles, with a 40% chance to leave each [Stunned] for 1 second.

fusions.name: Coiled Spring
fusions.desc: Springs you 3 tiles from where you stood, then increases your movement speed by 30% and your dodge chance by 10% for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: One of Nine
fusions.desc: Once every 300 seconds, a blow that would kill you leaves you at 1 health instead.
